cases.assertion: Cutover intentionally makes the frozen v1.2 literature-review capability automatic/default and makes scan non-default unless a reviewed v1.3+ contract supersedes it.
Figure, slides, and survey are registered explicit/non-default.
The cutover manifest enumerates every capability, stage route, Procedure ID/version/digest, validator binding, packed path, previous binding, cutover state, and rollback target.
Before a new activation, reverting the registry/inventory boundary restores the complete previous binding set atomically.
After a new activation, a reviewed registry rollback changes only future selection; recorded activations keep their original ID/version/digest and remain replayable.
Switching or rolling back current bindings never changes historical activation bytes or authority.
